commitments.text: OfflineDecisionTreeRunner: Executes the local decision tree engine to produce a deterministic triage result. Responsibility: Given a pet description and species, run the cached decision tree and return triage outcome. Dependencies: Decision tree asset (versioned, periodically refreshed), species mapping table. Owned data: None (stateless). Failure modes: Missing or corrupted tree asset -> fallback to error state; version mismatch -> trigger refresh.
commitments.rationale: Encapsulates the deterministic rule interpreter required by b_offline_004 and b_iface_offline_003.

commitments.text: The decision tree asset is cached locally with a version identifier. On app startup and periodically when online, the client checks for a newer version from the backend and replaces the cached tree atomically.
commitments.rationale: Implements b_offline_002 constraint for periodic refresh.

commitments.text: The local decision tree engine must never overwrite cloud-side veterinary modifications; all local triage results are stored as pending reports that require sync.

PendingReportRepository: Manages local persistence of pending reports using Room/SQLite. Responsibility: CRUD operations for pending reports, ensuring survival across app restarts. Dependencies: SQLite database, report ID generator. Owned data: Pending reports table with fields: report_id, creation_timestamp, status (pending, queued, syncing, merged, conflict), triage_data, vector_clock, clinic_id. Failure modes: Database corruption -> recovery from backup; disk full -> graceful failure with user notification.
commitments.rationale: Implements b_pending_001, b_pending_002, b_pending_004 and b_iface_lifecycle_002.

commitments.text: The local pending report store must not be treated as an authoritative diagnosis source for clinical decisions; it is a temporary buffer for sync.

SyncQueueManager: Manages the background FIFO queue of pending reports to be uploaded. Responsibility: Enqueue reports, process next report, handle success/failure callbacks. Dependencies: PendingReportRepository, RetryLedger, ConnectivityObserver, ClinicReplicaClient. Owned data: In-memory queue state (persisted via repository status). Failure modes: Queue stall due to persistent network failure -> exponential backoff; corrupted queue state -> rebuild from repository.
commitments.rationale: Implements b_sync_001, b_sync_003, b_sync_004 and b_iface_sync_004.

commitments.text: RetryLedger: Records each sync attempt with timestamp, HTTP status, error code, and retry count. Responsibility: Track sync attempts for monitoring and recovery. Dependencies: None (standalone table). Owned data: Retry ledger table with fields: report_id, attempt_timestamp, http_status, error_code, retry_count. Failure modes: Database write failure -> skip logging (non-critical).
The sync queue must not block the UI; all network operations run on a background coroutine thread.

If a sync attempt fails due to network error, the report remains in the queue with status 'queued' and a retry count is incremented. After a configurable number of retries, the report transitions to 'failed' for manual recovery.

ConflictResolver: Detects and manages vector clock conflicts between local and cloud versions. Responsibility: Compare vector clocks, determine if conflict exists, transition report to conflict state, and apply user resolution. Dependencies: PendingReportRepository, ClinicReplicaClient. Owned data: None (stateless). Failure modes: Clock skew -> false positive conflict; missing clock -> treat as new.
commitments.rationale: Implements b_conflict_001, b_conflict_003, b_conflict_004 and b_iface_conflict_001, b_iface_conflict_002, b_iface_conflict_003.

commitments.text: Clinical fields (diagnosis, vet edits, case status) use vector clock conflict detection; low-risk metadata (UI cursors, cache timestamps) use last-writer-wins.

UserConflictReviewPresenter: Presents a conflict resolution screen showing local and cloud versions with diff view. Responsibility: Display diff, capture clinician selection, and trigger resolution sync. Dependencies: ConflictResolver, PendingReportRepository. Owned data: None (UI state). Failure modes: UI thread blocking -> offload diff computation; user dismisses without resolving -> keep conflict state.
commitments.rationale: Implements b_uvc_001, b_uvc_002, b_uvc_003, b_uvc_004 and b_iface_conflict_004.

commitments.text: ClinicReplicaClient: Manages HTTP communication with clinic backends. Responsibility: Send reports to correct clinic URL, handle authentication, parse responses. Dependencies: Clinic registry (base URLs, auth tokens). Owned data: Clinic registry cache. Failure modes: Stale registry -> wrong backend (b_multiclinic_004); token expiry -> re-authenticate.
commitments.rationale: Implements b_multiclinic_001, b_multiclinic_002, b_multiclinic_003 and b_iface_offline_001, b_iface_sync_001.

commitments.text: AuditEventWriter: Records all local triage creation, sync attempts, conflict detections, and conflict resolutions. Responsibility: Append audit events to local store. Dependencies: PendingReportRepository (for report IDs). Owned data: Audit event table with fields: timestamp, actor (clinician ID), action_type, report_id, details. Failure modes: Store full -> enforce retention policy (b_audit_004); write failure -> non-blocking error log.

ConnectivityObserver: Monitors network connectivity and notifies SyncQueueManager. Responsibility: Provide connectivity status and changes. Dependencies: Android connectivity API. Owned data: None (stateless). Failure modes: False positive/negative -> sync attempts may fail or be delayed.
commitments.rationale: Supports b_sync_003 by enabling background sync only when online.

commitments.text: A recovery workflow allows clinicians to re-sync any pending report that has been stuck in 'failed' status, via a manual action in the UI.
